text_markup: A paid ability that refers to ice the Runner is approaching can only be used during the Approach Ice Phase of a run, and only if the ice being approached meets all stipulations used in referring to it.
text_plain: A paid ability that refers to ice the Runner is approaching can only be used during the Approach Ice Phase of a run, and only if the ice being approached meets all stipulations used in referring to it.

examples.text_markup: The Corp can only use the paid ability on {card:Project Wotan} while the Runner is approaching a rezzed piece of {subtype:bioroid} ice.
examples.text_plain: The Corp can only use the paid ability on Project Wotan while the Runner is approaching a rezzed piece of bioroid ice.
